Voter Privacy & Audit Notice

1. No PII Stored: No phone numbers, real names, or payment details are collected.

2. Anti-Cheat Fingerprinting: A SHA-256 cryptographic device hash is generated to enforce a strict 1-vote-per-day limit and catch staff self-voting.

3. Compliance: Adheres strictly to the Data Privacy Act of 2012 & GDPR guidelines.
